title: CLI command
description: Commands a person or a script runs in a terminal, shipped as an npm package. An item of the work type `command` needs an end-to-end test that starts the real binary, is run by the reviewer the way a reader of `--help` would, and is scored on help and errors, ergonomics, output and robustness against docs/CLI-CONVENTIONS.md. A milestone with such items is accepted from the packed and installed package. Publishing, version bumps and global installs are refused.
choose: The product has commands people run in a terminal.
